baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins arrogant departure, the Lord's binding command, seizure, the overhead shock, and contemporaneous looking.
baseline_models.mechanism: A binding sovereign direction is arrogantly refused; the resulting strike is therefore not bare impact but a culpability-linked seizure, and the final looking makes the seized people conscious witnesses within the event.

activation_trace.role: Arrogant departure from obedience supplies the initiating breach.
Binding request and obligation make the rejected matter directive rather than neutral.
Lordship and sovereignty locate authority behind the command.
Taking for a fault converts impact into accountable seizure.
The upper crash supplies the concrete overwhelming event.
Directed sight makes them present witnesses rather than absent objects.

changed_reading.before: A people are struck while they happen to be looking.
changed_reading.after: Their arrogant refusal of binding lordly direction is answered by a culpability-seizure that they consciously witness as it closes over them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The terminal-state branch of عتو stands against the reparative and formative branch of رب, while أخذ and صعق can describe a bodily condition that overwhelms its subject.
baseline_models.mechanism: Refusal has matured from an act into a hardened state no longer open to repair. Against a Lord characterized by gradual formation and completion, the shock manifests failed formation as a condition that takes the body and extinguishes ordinary awareness.

activation_trace.role: Terminal age or condition supplies hardening beyond easy repair.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the formative relation being resisted.
A condition taking hold in the body turns seizure into embodied takeover.
Stupefaction or death gives the terminal state its bodily endpoint.

changed_reading.before: They break a rule and receive an external punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their refusal hardens into failed formation under the One who nurtures and repairs, until an overwhelming condition bodily realizes that terminal state.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command root also carries a marker or appointment, and the looking root also carries waiting and granted delay.
baseline_models.mechanism: The lordly matter can be heard as bearing a marked threshold as well as an imperative. Those still waiting or expecting time are grasped when that threshold arrives as an overhead event.

activation_trace.role: A sign or appointed time supplies a latent temporal boundary within the command.
Grasping supplies the instant when open time becomes capture.
The descending crash materializes the marked threshold.
Waiting, expectation, and delay make their looking temporally charged.

changed_reading.before: The shock interrupts an otherwise unmarked act of sight.
changed_reading.after: An awaited or presumed interval expires: the marked lordly threshold takes them while they are still oriented toward more time.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding Pharaoh sequence sends compelling, disclosed authority, meets a turn away made with a strong support, and then takes ruler and mutually supporting force together. This revises the focus plural from isolated private disobedience toward power-backed refusal whose support system is implicated in the seizure.

activation_trace.role: Arrogant noncompliance remains the focus anchor for the parallel refusal.
Compelling proof makes the refused communication evidentially forceful.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign removes obscurity as the primary cause of refusal.
Turning away supplies the neighboring behavioral analogue to departure from command.
A strong side leaned upon makes refusal structurally supported.
Capturing the ruler parallels the focus seizure as loss of agency.
A mutually supporting force broadens capture from an individual to his sustaining body.

structural_cues: 51:38-40 forms a send, turn, and take sequence immediately before the Thamud sequence.
The explicit inclusion of the ruler's force in 51:40 enlarges the object of taking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a supported turn and collective capture; I transfer that social mechanism to the plural defiance in 51:44. A live alternative is that the parallel marks only repeated guilt, not a comparable support structure.

changed_reading.before: A group privately refuses and is struck.
changed_reading.after: The refusal can be read as socially supported resistance, and the taking as collapse of the resistant body together with the supports on which it relied.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent punishment is sterile and converts what it reaches into decay. That material sequence sharpens the focus tension between terminal عتو and reparative رب: rebellion appears not only juridically wrong but anti-fruitful, ending in a state that can no longer be cultivated.

activation_trace.role: An irreparable terminal condition anchors the focus side of the analogy.
Nurture and repair provide the productive relation being negated.
The sterile wind supplies a material image of force without fruit.
Transformation into a new condition supplies the causal material transition.
Decay supplies the terminal material result.

structural_cues: Sterility and decay occupy the immediately preceding punishment account.
The focus follows with terminal-state and nurturing branch possibilities in direct tension.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sterile force, transformation, decay, terminality, and nurture; I infer an ecological analogy between failed cultivation and hardened refusal. The alternative is that the two punishment media are merely successive examples.

changed_reading.before: Their defiance is a discrete legal violation.
changed_reading.after: Their defiance has become sterile terminality: a refusal of formative nurture that ends in an uncultivable state.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the focus, benefit is extended to a bounded time; after it, capacity, standing, and self-help vanish. The shock is the hinge where chosen noncompliance and presumed delay become imposed incapacity.

activation_trace.role: Waiting and granted delay make their looking the posture of an expiring respite.
A marker or appointment links command to the bounded interval.
Extended enjoyment supplies real but temporary continuance.
The proper time of a thing fixes the endpoint of continuance.
Obedient pliancy supplies the root-level counterpart they had refused.
Ability and capacity supply the post-shock faculty now absent.
Bodily standing gives incapacity a concrete vertical form.
Aid and self-vindicating support mark the social capacity also lost.

structural_cues: 51:43 grants enjoyment until a time, 51:44 is the seizure, and 51:45 states the resulting inability.
The shared طوع field juxtaposes voluntary pliancy with physical capacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded enjoyment before and inability after; I identify the focus as the conversion point from chosen noncompliance to involuntary incapacity. The alternative is a simpler before-and-after chronology without a moral reversal in طوع.

changed_reading.before: The people are suddenly struck during sight.
changed_reading.after: They are taken at the expiry of a real respite, precisely where the ability they would not bend becomes an inability even to stand or secure help.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence builds by joining, empowers, expands, prepares, and measures creation. These constructive operations amplify the formative branch of رب and revise أمر from an isolated decree into direction situated within a sustaining order.

activation_trace.role: Nurture, repair, and completion anchor the focus in formative lordship.
The Lord's affair can encompass an ordered mode of governance.
Joining parts into a construction supplies coherent assembly.
Supporting strength supplies power that sustains the assembly.
Expansion against constriction supplies an open, ongoing scale.
Preparing and leveling an affair supplies habitable ordering.
Measuring a thing supplies proportion and purposive formation.

structural_cues: The discourse moves directly from failed standing to cosmic building, spreading, and measured creation.
Several constructive verbs follow the title رب in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies constructive operations after judgment; I let them specify the formative scope of رب and أمر. A live alternative is that the creation sequence begins a new exhortation and should not causally explain the shock.

changed_reading.after: They reject direction embedded in the same formative order that assembles, strengthens, expands, prepares, and measures their world.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus movement is away from the Lord's command; the later imperative redirects flight toward God under an awakening and explicit warning. The seizure thus arrests a wrong-way vector, not merely a static refusal.

activation_trace.role: Departure from obedience supplies motion away from the command.
Grasping supplies the arrest of that outward motion.
Flight supplies urgent directed movement rather than passive assent.
The worshipped One supplies the destination of corrective flight.
Warning that awakens caution supplies urgency before capture.
Disclosed meaning makes the direction of escape explicit.

structural_cues: The focus construction uses عن for movement away, while 51:50 uses إلى for movement toward.
Both movements are attached to lordly or divine direction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed prepositional vectors and the roots of departure, grasping, and flight; I read them as a directional reversal. The alternative is that عتو marks degree of disobedience without spatial force.

changed_reading.before: They refuse a command and are caught.
changed_reading.after: They travel morally in the wrong direction, away from command; the shock catches that flight before the later call identifies the only viable direction, toward God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same labels recur around messengers, yet the text questions literal transmission and attributes recurrence to transgression. The focus defiance therefore becomes one local performance of a self-reproducing social voice that neutralizes warning by naming it away.

activation_trace.role: Arrogant noncompliance anchors the recurring script back in the focus.
Messenger and message supply the repeatedly targeted communication.
Speech spreading among people supplies social replication of the labels.
Deceptive diversion supplies one label used to displace the message.
A mind covered by madness supplies the alternative discrediting label.
Mutual bequeathing supplies the questioned model of direct transmission.
Exceeding the limit in disobedience supplies the stated generator of recurrence.
The raised collective voice supplies an exploratory image for communal amplification.

structural_cues: 51:52 repeats the exact sorcerer-or-madman pair already used in 51:39.
51:53 contrasts direct mutual bequeathing with a shared transgressive condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated labels, questions direct transmission, and names transgression; I infer a social mechanism that independently reproduces the same dismissive voice. The alternative is simple historical recurrence without interpersonal amplification.

changed_reading.before: The focus community commits its own isolated act of defiance.
changed_reading.after: Its defiance participates in a recurring social script: communities amplify familiar labels until warning can be dismissed without being answered.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation is directed toward humble service, while provision and feeding are explicitly not needed from creatures; the provider possesses gathered strength and extended solidity. The Lord's command in the focus is therefore formative for dependents, not extractive for a needy ruler.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion frame lordship as creature-forming care.
Binding direction supplies the creature-facing demand.
Humble obedience supplies the created relation that command is to form.
An apportioned gift marks provision as something creatures might wrongly imagine supplying.
Feeding another supplies the explicitly denied service to God.
Apportioned giving reverses the imagined direction of dependence.
Gathered strength like corded strands supplies self-sufficient power.
Extended solidity supplies durable, non-dependent capacity.

structural_cues: 51:56-58 states purpose, denies divine need, and identifies God as provider and strong.
These claims retrospectively specify the relation compressed in the focus title رب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies created service, denied divine need, provision, and strength; I infer that the focus command benefits and forms the commanded rather than supplying the Commander. The alternative is to keep these later claims doctrinally true but separate from the earlier seizure.

changed_reading.before: A sovereign punishes subjects for withholding demanded service.
changed_reading.after: Dependents reject a formative command from the provider who needs nothing from them; the seizure exposes their dependence rather than repairing any lack in the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing warning gives wrongdoers a share figured as a full bucket like that of their companions, forbids hastening, and fixes a promised day. In contact with the focus appointment, waiting, and water-holding branches, the seizure becomes a measured allotment filling at its proper time.

activation_trace.role: Marker or appointment supplies a fixed point for the allotted event.
A basin that holds water supplies the exploratory receiving-container image.
Waiting and delay supply the temporal posture before the allotment arrives.
A share or portion supplies measured equivalence with predecessors.
A full bucket supplies the concrete image of a completed allotment.
Equivalence makes this allotment comparable to that of prior companions.
Hastening or advancing the event supplies the denied timing manipulation.
A bounded duration supplies the final temporal container.
An appointment fixed by time or place supplies the promised endpoint.

structural_cues: The surah closes by comparing a wrongdoer's portion with that of predecessors and by controlling its timing.
The focus is one predecessor event inside that closing comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies share, full-bucket, equivalence, delay, and appointment images; I map the focus taking onto a container receiving its measured fill. The live alternative is that the bucket is only an idiom for share and should not materially color أخذ.

changed_reading.before: The shock is an unmeasured eruption that happens to overtake them.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their seizure is the filling of an allotted share at a fixed time, continuous with the measured portions promised to comparable communities.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the grammar says the people look, whereas the cited branch personifies time as looking at and destroying people. It remains anchored in the focus looking root and its immediate seizure, but downstream prose should render it only as a secondary reversal-image, never as the clause's direct syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The watchers are grasped by the destructive event at the instant of looking.

activation_trace.role: The destroying glance of time reverses sight back upon the watchers.
Grasping gives the reversed glance effective capture.
The overhead crash embodies the event that appears to look back.

changed_reading.before: They retain the one-way agency of spectators until impact.
changed_reading.after: As a contained image, their gaze is reversed: the destructive moment looks back, turns spectators into its objects, and takes them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because رب is syntactically the Lord, not cloud or rising breath, and one image comes through the packet's non-dominant ر ب و mapping. It remains worth carrying as a sound-root echo linking title, body, and overhead crash; downstream prose must preserve the theological title and qualify the atmospheric layer as resonance only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The title رب stands inside a scene of an overhead shock and exposed looking.

activation_trace.role: Layered cloud gives the lordship root an atmospheric echo without replacing its title sense.
Rising or swollen breath adds a bodily vertical response from the split mapping.
The upper crash joins the atmospheric and bodily echoes in one event.
A thing exposed to view makes the charged scene visibly present.

changed_reading.before: The divine title and the atmospheric shock occupy separate semantic planes.
changed_reading.after: As a qualified echo only, layered cloud, rising breath, overhead crash, and exposed view make lordship reverberate through the material scene.

strongest_changes: The focus becomes the hinge from bounded enjoyment to total incapacity, with طوع reversing refused pliancy into lost ability.
The opposed vectors عن and إلى recast defiance as wrong-way flight that seizure arrests.
The Pharaoh parallel broadens private refusal into support-backed resistance whose sustaining body can be taken with it.
Later purpose and provision language recasts the Lord's command as formative for dependents rather than extractive for a needy sovereign.
The closing share, full-bucket, and appointment field preserves an exploratory reading of the shock as a measured allotment arriving on time.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activation came from reversals rather than topical similarity: obedience became inability, movement away answered movement toward, watchers became objects of a returning gaze, and an apparently abrupt strike became both expired respite and measured share.
remaining_uncertainties: The transfer from Pharaoh's explicit support structure to Thamud's plural defiance is analogical, not stated.
The constructive creation sequence may clarify formative lordship without directly explaining the earlier shock.
The container, returning-gaze, cloud, and rising-breath readings are branch-backed resonances and must not be promoted into direct lexical translations.
